name: claudetto-you-should-know
description: Shows a short note above the prompt when a side check finds something about the work you likely missed. Off by default; once on, one small request every sixth step, no telemetry.

sideCheckEnabled.title: Side check
sideCheckEnabled.description: Use `true` to turn the side check on. Left at `false`, every hook of this plugin passes straight through and nothing is requested, so an installed copy costs nothing until it is turned on.

sideCheckModel.title: Side check model
sideCheckModel.description: The model that answers each check. The default is the small model that `docs/models.md` assigns to a handoff or a summary.

sideCheckEffortLevel.title: Side check effort
sideCheckEffortLevel.description: How hard the model thinks about each check.
